title: StableSemantics: A Synthetic Language-Vision Dataset of Semantic Representations in Naturalistic Images

bias_targets.methodology: Averaging and visualizing the spatial distribution of diffusion attribution masks for specific semantic concepts (e.g., sunset, floor, hair) across generated images to demonstrate non-uniform object placement.

Visualizing the semantic distribution of generated images and natural language captions using UMAP with CLIP embeddings to identify high-frequency conceptual clusters (e.g., people, animals) driven by human user preferences.
Observing and noting shifts in the semantic distribution of human-submitted prompts and generated images around specific temporal events, such as major holidays (e.g., Thanksgiving, Christmas).
